layers.message: Document CSV export in usage guide

graderOnly: docs/usage.md says a successful export returns 200, shows the header example filename records-20260924.csv, and says files are named records-<YYYYMMDD>.csv with a later same-day export replacing that day's file. The implementation returns 201 and names files records-<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>.csv by UTC time to the second, so only a same-second export replaces a file. This is the only documentation defect.
The completed final-deliverable review assessed docs/usage.md at its current (defective) content and marked AC-002 Supported, so correcting the guide invalidates that completed final review.
After the guide is corrected, the full Documenter gate passes: every other documentation surface and AC disposition in the documentation record remains accurate.

Correct routing: Documenter owns Frame 1 (RerunThrough NONE). After correcting and passing its gate it keeps the frame, sets RerunThrough to REVIEWING_FINAL, and transitions to REVIEWING_FINAL for a FINAL_DELIVERABLE rerun; Synchronizer resumes only after that rerun pops the frame.

all.why: the rerun boundary is the earliest required rerun state, so the frame owner transitions there
Claude Code invocation for the Reviewer
directs the Reviewer to the active recovery frame
Documenter does not write the synchronization record or close its discrepancy

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Documenter does not change behavior or tests
Documenter does not edit other roles' records

selfChecks.why: integration suite passes, including the 201 and file-name assertions
the DOCUMENTING recovery state and records are valid

selfChecks.cmd: grep -qF 'On success the service returns `200`' docs/usage.md && grep -qF 'records-<YYYYMMDD>.csv' docs/usage.md && grep -qF 'records-20260924.csv' docs/usage.md && grep -qF 'same day replaces' docs/usage.md
selfChecks.why: the guide states the wrong success status and date-only file naming

selfChecks.cmd: grep -qF 'status: 201' src/routes/export.ts && grep -qF 'assert.equal(response.status, 201)' test/integration/export-flow.test.ts && grep -qF 'records-20260924T090000Z.csv' test/integration/export-flow.test.ts
selfChecks.why: the implementation returns 201 and names files to the second

selfChecks.cmd: grep -qF 'WorkflowState`: `DOCUMENTING`' .standards/STATE.md && grep -qF '`Kind`: `FAILURE` `From`: `SYNCHRONIZING` `FailureType`: `DOCUMENTATION`' .standards/STATE.md && grep -qF '`Owner`: `DOCUMENTING`' .standards/STATE.md && grep -qF '`ResumeAt`: `SYNCHRONIZING` `RerunThrough`: `NONE`' .standards/STATE.md && test $(grep -c '^### Frame' .standards/STATE.md) -eq 1 && grep -qF '`BlockedOn`: `NONE`' .standards/STATE.md
selfChecks.why: one recovery frame owned by DOCUMENTING, resuming SYNCHRONIZING, RerunThrough NONE

selfChecks.cmd: f=.standards/docs/reviews/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2/final-deliverable.md && s=.standards/docs/synchronization/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md && d=.standards/docs/documentation/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md && grep -qx 'ReviewKind: FINAL_DELIVERABLE' $f && grep -qF '`Status`: `COMPLETE`' $f && grep -qF '`Status`: `IN_PROGRESS`' $s && grep -q '^### D-001' $s && grep -qF '`Status`: `COMPLETE`' $d
selfChecks.why: completed documentation and final review, in-progress synchronization with one discrepancy

selfChecks.cmd: ! git status --porcelain | grep -q . && test ! -e exports && ! grep -rqE 'COMMIT:|BLOB:' .standards/docs
selfChecks.why: clean tree, no export files, placeholders resolved

notes: Built on export-documenting. 50-guide commits docs/usage.md with a new 'Exporting records as CSV' section (roles note, filters, response, saved file, CSV format, export errors, Errors-table note) and a README link sentence naming exports; the section wrongly says success returns 200 and files are records-<YYYYMMDD>.csv replaced by same-day exports. 52-documentation commits a COMPLETE documentation record (AUTONOMOUS, ACTIVE_CHANGE, NONE style) accounting for AC-001 and AC-002, citing BLOB/COMMIT identities; STATE to REVIEWING_FINAL FORWARD from DOCUMENTING. 55-final-review commits a COMPLETE FINAL_DELIVERABLE review with no findings that assessed docs/usage.md at its current blob and marked AC-002 Supported; STATE to SYNCHRONIZING. 60-sync commits an IN_PROGRESS synchronization record with D-001 (OPEN, Owner Documenter, FailureType DOCUMENTATION) describing the status and file-name mismatch, and STATE DOCUMENTING with Handoff FAILURE from SYNCHRONIZING and Frame 1 From SYNCHRONIZING, Owner DOCUMENTING, ResumeAt SYNCHRONIZING, RerunThrough NONE. No record says which downstream work must rerun; the Documenter must infer from the final review's assessed guide identity that it is invalidated. check.mjs passes (only the current state's COMPLETE documentation record is held during recovery, and it covers both ACs).
